> CI Pipeline appears to have just used a cached copy instead of recompiling.

that is because lzma is not a default feature of libzip.

That is the problem:
`E:/vcpkg_folders/liblzma/buildtrees/libzippp/src/32217e672c-26e2865e9c.clean/cmake/FindLIBZIP.cmake(53):  find_package(LibLZMA::LibLZMA REQUIRED )`

basically 90% of the `find_package` calls in `FindLIBZIP.cmake` are nonsense. Wonder if it worked before.
@Neumann-A exciting. I'll make sure to fix it.
@StarGate-One if you're interested, you can look into it; any questions you have should be asked on the #include<C++> discord, in the #vcpkg channel :)
`--trace` or `--trace-expand` are the magic options for cmake / `vcpkg_configure_cmake` to get enough log info to debug such errors and see what is going on.

> at the risk of sounding dumb, where would I put these options - I tried modifying/adding them to then end of the command line in vcpkg_build_cmake.cmake and vcpkg_configure_cmake.cmake with no results

in the `portfile` into the `vcpkg_configure_cmake` call as `OPTIONS` parameter

somewhere in the `portfile` there should be a
```
vcpkg_configure_cmake(<something something>
                      OPTIONS --trace
                      <something something>
```

alternativly you can use `--trace-expand` instead of `--trace`
OK @Neumann-A I give it a try a little later. Thank you👍👍👍
